target: a one-file build prompt for a local business website
prompt: Write me the paste-and-build prompt for a website for an independent bike repair shop in Leeds (opening hours, services and prices, how to book). Save it as site-prompt.md.
rubric: Narrows the topic to a concrete subject and derives the concept from it
Builds and verifies the site in a scratch folder before writing the prompt
Embeds every file verbatim with a pinned stack and the checks that actually ran
Marks invented business details (prices, hours) as placeholders for the owner rather than facts
